output.reason: [ev-17b3774eb9ee] tells operators to make sure the StableConnectIdentities feature gate is enabled and StrimziPodSets are used before upgrading. That is a mandatory step before the upgrade, so migration-required (action) is the right kind. The proposed statement leaves out the scope "upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older", so it reads as if every Connect or MirrorMaker 2 user must do this. The evidence also does not say what fails if the step is skipped, so the corrected statement says that rather than inventing a failure.

correction.statement: When upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 from Strimzi 0.38 or older with Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 operands, the StableConnectIdentities feature gate must be enabled and StrimziPodSets used before the upgrade (migration-required).

consequence.statement: Operators upgrading from Strimzi 0.38 or older who run Kafka Connect or Kafka MirrorMaker 2 must enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and use StrimziPodSets before upgrading to 0.46.0. The evidence does not say what fails if this step is skipped.
consequence.remediation: On the current (0.38 or older) operator, enable the StableConnectIdentities feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSets are used for Connect and MirrorMaker 2, then upgrade.
